_vars: {d}=driver, {n}=other driver, {t}=tyre letter, {p}=position. Keys starting with rc_ are Race Control messages, the rest are your race engineer.
start: Lights out and away we go. Focus on the first lap, {d}.
Clean start please, {d}. Tyres are good to go.
Race is on. Keep it tidy through turn one, {d}.
pit: Box this lap, {d}. Box, box. We go for {t} tyres.
{d}, box box. Fresh {t}s waiting for you.
lowtyre: {d}, tyres are dropping off. Look after them.
Tyre life is getting low, {d}. Pit window opening soon.
Watch the rears, {d}. Degradation is rising.
gain: Good job {d}, you are now P{p}.
lost: {d}, you dropped to P{p}. Stay calm, we have time.
Lost a place, {d}. P{p}. Push to get it back.
P{p} now, {d}. Use your DRS next lap.
fastest: Purple sector, {d}! That is the fastest lap of the race.
{d}, you have the fastest lap. Keep it up.
pen_own: {d}, track limits. Five seconds added to your time.
Bad news {d}, five second penalty for exceeding track limits.
{d}, warning turned to penalty. Five seconds.
dnf_own: {d}, we have a problem. Stop the car, stop the car.
Retire the car, {d}. Box this lap to retire.
{d}, I am sorry, you are out of the race.
lastlap: One more lap, {d}. Everything you have got.
rc_sc: Safety car, safety car. Slow down, keep the gap.
Incident on track. Safety car is out.
rc_scend: Safety car in this lap. Restart is coming.
Safety car ending. Green flag next lap.
Safety car will go in at the end of this lap.
rc_pen: Five second penalty for {d}: exceeding track limits.
{d} receives five seconds for track limits.
rc_dnf: Retirement for {d}. The car is stopped on track.
{d} has stopped. Out of the race.
rc_collision: {d} and {n} have collided. Stewards are looking at it.
rc_stew: Stewards decision: {d} caused a collision. Five second penalty.
Stewards: {d} is to blame. Five seconds added.
Collision ruled as {d}'s fault. Five second penalty.
